dedupe_keys.name: itzi gis model for urban flood simulation with surface and drainage network coupling

description: Itzï is a GIS model for urban flood simulation that couples a surface flow model with a drainage network model, so that culverts and inundation from drainage overflows can be represented. Laurent Courty produced it on top of GRASS GIS, which supplies the computational region and the spatial and temporal analysis tools. Coverage is any area prepared as GRASS maps. Itzï is free software under the GPL, with documentation for version 26.6 covering installation on GNU/Linux and Windows, command line use, a tutorial with surface and culvert modelling, the configuration file and a programmer's manual. Caveats: it depends on GRASS GIS, and the FAQ discusses numerical instabilities and differences between resumed and uninterrupted runs. Simulation uses: flood risk maps, critical points of drainage networks and the effect of climate change or flood defences on urban flooding. Related records: EPA SWMM (model-epa-swmm) and LISFLOOD-FP (model-lisflood-fp).
